title: Untitled (Targets and Discs) 4
description: Mixed-media collage layering shooting-range target sheets, compact discs, iridescent holographic foil, and gestural charcoal drawing on white paper. Brown tape fragments, a turquoise vertical strip, and glittery iridescent material occupy the left and lower edges alongside loosely rendered figurative line work.
composition: layered fragments across horizontal picture plane
